messages:
kira: quick callout  found a handful of console observability examples referencing the old 'cost_widget' key and the trace examples still using X-Trace-Context. planning a small focused PR to: 1) rename cost_widget -> cost_widget_v2, 2) update trace examples to use traceparent and the SDK attach helper, 3) fix a couple of stale internal links. who can pick pieces?

tom: I can do the JSON rename and add a 1-line migration snippet showing sed/perl mapping. will also add a short FAQ blurb about why the key changed (aggregation semantics).

anna: grabbing SDK snippets (python + node). will show the attach-from-headers helper and prefer factory usage. keeping Rust as a "see reference" to keep PR small.

docbot: link-checker: 1 broken link found in docs/console/presets.md -> /internal/widgets/cost (404)

kira: thanks docbot. tom add a redirect for /internal/widgets/cost -> /console/widgets/cost_widget_v2 please.

tom: pushed branch docs/cost-key-migration with JSON rename, redirect, brief changelog entry. example migration script:```bash
# map old key to new in all presets
find docs/console/presets -name '*.json' -exec sed -i 's/"cost_widget"/"cost_widget_v2"/g' {} +
```

anna: python snippet draft:```python
from redwood import ConsoleClient
client = ConsoleClient.factory()
headers = { 'traceparent': '00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00' }
client.attach_trace_from_headers(headers)
```

anna: node snippet draft:```javascript
const { ConsoleClient } = require('redwood')
const client = ConsoleClient.factory()
const headers = { traceparent: '00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00' }
client.attachTraceFromHeaders(headers)
```

kira: nice. keeping the snippets intentionally minimal. reviewers: @tom for JSON/redirect, @anna for snippets, @kira for migration text. can we aim to merge by EOD so staging includes it tomorrow?

merge-bot: staging cutoff 2026-04-05T02:00:00Z for next deploy. PRs merged before 2026-04-04T23:00:00Z included.

tom: CI green locally, pushed PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/docs/pulls/4301

docbot: link-checker: re-run: broken link fixed in PR 4301

kira: quick review done. one nit on wording in the migration note. anna please squash and use the client factory pattern in both snippets (you already did).

anna: squashed + addressed nit. PR updated.

merge-bot: CI passed for PR 4301. merging now.

kira: merged. adding a short note in release notes: "console: migrate cost_widget to cost_widget_v2; see migration guide". will track telemetry for any presets still using old key and follow up next sprint. thanks all :sparkles:
